mechanism: Amoxicillin-clavulanate may inhibit phenytoin metabolism and increase serum phenytoin levels, while phenytoin may increase amoxicillin metabolism; amoxicillin can also displace phenytoin from protein binding.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum levels and clinical toxicity signs; consider phenytoin dose adjustment if levels become elevated; watch for signs of phenytoin toxicity (ataxia, nystagmus, confusion).
